name: Solid User Tests
description_en:
Solid User Tests helps teams prepare remote usability sessions, manage their own participant pool and analyze recordings.

Its virtual guide briefs testers and reminds them to think aloud, while annual editor/session pricing excludes recruitment and needs to be matched to the actual study workload.
description_zh:
Solid User Tests 帮助团队准备远程可用性会话、管理自有参与者库并分析录像。

虚拟引导角色负责说明任务并提醒出声思考；年度编辑者/会话报价不包含招募，需要按实际研究量选择。

core_features.name_zh: 有引导的独立测试会话
core_features.explanation_en: Anna briefs participants, helps with setup and reminds quiet testers to think aloud, according to the product pages.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按产品页说明，Anna 向参与者讲解、协助设置，并在安静时提醒出声思考。

core_features.explanation_en: Teams can maintain their own pool, track previous sessions and share target-audience registration/consent forms.
core_features.explanation_zh: 团队可维护自有参与者库、跟踪既往会话，并分享针对目标人群的注册/同意表单。

core_features.name_zh: 参与者上传前先在本地录制
core_features.explanation_en: The features page says testers record locally and then decide whether to upload and share; this does not imply all subsequent processing stays local.
core_features.explanation_zh: 功能页说测试者先本地录制，再决定上传分享，不代表后续全部处理都在本地。

sections.title_en: Use the guide to support thinking aloud
sections.en:
The product presents Anna as an avatar that briefs participants, explains that the goal is not merely fast task completion and reminds them to think aloud when quiet. Feature documentation adds device setup, tasks/questions and audio-visual instructions. These are documented auto-moderation aids; the read pages do not establish an adaptive AI interview model or equivalence to a skilled human moderator.

For a hypothetical prototype test, prepare a neutral task and check that the instructions do not disclose the desired route. Pilot whether the participant can start recording and explain their reasoning without excessive prompts. A reminder can improve verbalization but may also interrupt concentration; judge it against the research question. The site’s “five times faster” testimonial was not adopted as a verified performance result. No avatar behavior or participant session was tested.
sections.zh:
产品将 Anna 描述为虚拟角色，负责向参与者说明任务，解释研究不只是尽快完成，并在安静时提醒出声思考。功能文档增加设备设置、任务/问题及视听说明。这些是文档自动引导辅助，已读页面没有建立自适应 AI 访谈模型，也不能证明等同于熟练真人主持。

以原型测试为假设，应准备中立任务并检查说明不会泄露目标路线。先试点参与者能否开始录制并解释推理，而不需要过多提示。提醒可能帮助表达，也可能打断注意，应按研究问题评估。网站“快五倍”的客户评价未作为已验证性能结果。本研究未测试虚拟角色或参与者会话。

sections.title_en: Bring the participant context into recording review
sections.title_zh: 将参与者背景带入录像分析
sections.en:
Solid documents a private research pool, previous-session tracking and audience-specific registration/consent forms. Testers are described as not needing software installation and recording sessions locally before choosing upload/share. Reviewers can analyze recordings together and inspect additional behavioral information. The homepage says prototypes work best, while websites and apps are also supported; the exact browser, mobile and app-capture coverage was not specified in the read material.

A useful review workflow is to retain task wording, participant eligibility and prototype version alongside each recording, then connect every proposed UI change to an observed moment. A registration form does not by itself ensure a complete recording notice or authorization for sensitive screens. Check the actual participant-facing experience and access controls before a client study. No upload, consent flow or analysis interface was executed.
sections.zh:
Solid 文档描述私有研究人群库、既往会话跟踪和按人群区分的注册/同意表单。测试者被描述为无需安装软件，先在本地录制，再决定上传/分享。评审者可协作分析录像并查看额外行为信息。首页说最适合原型，也支持网站和 App，但已读材料未明确浏览器、移动及 App 录制覆盖。

评审建议是将任务措辞、参与者资格和原型版本与每份录像一起保留，再把每个 UI 调整关联到观察时刻。注册表单本身不能保证录制通知完整或敏感屏幕已获授权。客户研究前应检查真实参与者界面和访问控制。本研究未执行上传、同意流程或分析界面。

sections.title_en: Price the actual editor and recording configuration
sections.title_zh: 按实际编辑者和录像配置报价
sections.en:
The browser-rendered Pro calculator showed three researchers/editors and 100 recordings per year at USD 290 per month equivalent, explicitly USD 3,480 per year excluding VAT. This is one observed configuration, not a confirmed minimum or universal flat price. Team members without editing rights are described as free. Enterprise is custom and adds multiple teams, SSO and an individual contract.

The page says the contract period is one year and cancellation takes effect at the contract end. Recruitment is excluded; it suggests partners such as TestingTime, Prolific and User Interviews. Count both the required annual sessions and the actual number of editors, then budget external recruitment and participant compensation separately. “Start free” does not specify a permanent free plan, its session allowance or trial duration in the read material. No calculator change, quote, payment or cancellation was performed.
sections.zh:
浏览器渲染的 Pro 计算器显示三个研究者/编辑者、每年 100 份录像，折合每月 USD290，并明确写每年 USD3,480、不含 VAT。这是观察到的一种配置，不是已确认最低价或统一固定价。没有编辑权的团队成员被描述为免费。Enterprise 定制，并增加多团队、SSO 和独立合同。

页面说合同期一年，取消在合同期末生效。招募不包含在内，建议使用 TestingTime、Prolific、User Interviews 等伙伴。应同时计算年度所需会话和实际编辑者人数，再单独预算外部招募及参与者报酬。“免费开始”没有在已读材料中明确永久免费档、会话额度或试用长度。本研究未修改计算器，也未执行询价、付款或取消。

sections.title_en: Swiss hosting is a provider statement, not a full data map
sections.title_zh: 瑞士托管是厂商声明，不是完整数据流图
sections.en:
The feature and pricing pages say data is hosted in Zurich/Switzerland and advertise GDPR compliance. The privacy notice is dated May 20,2022 and describes purpose-based retention, deletion/anonymization when no longer needed and backup isolation until deletion is possible. These statements do not establish a specific recording deletion deadline or prove that every subprocessor, support action and integration stays in one region.

The Terms of Use, dated May 23,2022, reserve proprietary platform rights and include generic personal/noncommercial site-content language, while the current product sells business research plans. The exact paid-service agreement, recording rights and account-specific data-processing commitments should therefore be confirmed rather than treating the generic website terms as a complete procurement contract. No compliance audit, residency inspection or deletion test was conducted.
sections.zh:
功能及价格页说数据托管在苏黎世/瑞士，并宣传 GDPR 合规。2022 年 5 月 20 日隐私通知描述按目的保留、不再需要时删除/匿名化，以及备份无法立即删除时隔离到可删除为止。这些说明没有建立录像具体删除期限，也不证明每个分处理方、支持操作和集成都在同一地域。

2022 年 5 月 23 日使用条款保留专有平台权利，并包含通用的个人/非商业网站内容措辞，而现行产品出售企业研究套餐。因此应确认实际付费服务合同、录像权利及账户数据处理承诺，不能将通用网站条款当成完整采购合同。未开展合规审计、地域检查或删除测试。

sections.title_zh: 评估一个完整参与者会话
sections.en:
Solid is a documentation-based candidate when a team has relevant participants and wants guided independent tasks plus collaborative recording review. An evaluation should confirm device setup, the think-aloud prompts, recording upload choice, usable audio/screen capture and the required researcher/viewer permissions. Then check how the selected annual allowance counts retries, incomplete sessions and participant uploads.

Those operational rules, export formats, account retention after nonrenewal, current accessibility and sensitive-data restrictions were not established here. The record replaces a directory-style name suffix with the actual Solid User Tests product name, while preserving its canonical file identity and draft status. No study quality or customer outcome is claimed.
sections.zh:
如果团队已有合适参与者，希望结合独立任务引导和协作录像评审，文档显示 Solid 可作为候选。评估应确认设备设置、出声思考提示、录制上传选择、可用音频/屏幕，以及所需研究者/查看者权限，再检查选中年度额度如何计算重试、未完成会话和参与者上传。

这些操作规则、导出格式、不续费后保留、当前可访问性及敏感数据限制尚未建立。本记录将目录式名称后缀改为真实产品名 Solid User Tests，同时保留规范文件身份和草稿状态，不声称已证明研究质量或客户成果。
